headline: Greeks Among the Major Ship Buyers – Who Is Investing in Bulkers and Tankers
summary: Used-vessel buying is moving quickly in 2026, with Greek shipping interests, large Asian groups and Chinese leasing companies investing billions of dollars in bulk carriers and tankers.
why: Shipping asset prices and charter rates for bulk carriers and tankers are central to freight costs and global trade flows. Investors track vessel values as a gauge of the shipping cycle.
